parameters.command:
sqlite3 -json /data/arabic_dict.db "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, d.name_ar, d.source_type
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.headword_norm IN ('غريب الاطوار', 'الغريب الاطوار');
" > /tmp/query1.json
sqlite3 -json /data/arabic_dict.db "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.headword_norm, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, d.name_ar, d.source_type
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_translations_fts
    WHERE entries_translations_fts MATCH 'translation_en:\"kook\" OR translation_en:\"odd fellow\" OR translation_en:\"odd fish\" OR translation_en:\"queer bird\" OR translation_en:\"queer duck\" OR translation_en:\"odd man out\" OR translation_en:\"eccentric\" OR translation_en:\"weirdo\"'
    ORDER BY bm25(entries_translations_fts, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    LIMIT 20
);
" > /tmp/query2.json
sqlite3 -json /data/arabic_dict.db "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.headword_norm, e.definitions_text, d.name_ar, d.source_type
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_fts
    WHERE entries_fts MATCH '\"غريب الاطوار\" OR \"شخص شاذ\" OR \"شخص غريب\"'
    ORDER BY bm25(entries_fts, 10.0, 5.0, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    LIMIT 20
);
" > /tmp/query3.json
cat /tmp/query1.json /tmp/query2.json /tmp/query3.json
